title: devx.config.yaml
description: Schema for devx.config.yaml — covers all 15 sections from docs/CONFIG.md plus the projects/stack block consumed by the local-CI gate. Required keys: `mode`, `project.shape`. Everything else has defaults supplied by mode + shape + thoroughness. Unknown keys are intentionally allowed at runtime — the load-time validator (cfg203) downgrades them to warnings so devx upgrades that introduce new keys don't brick existing configs.

devx_version.description: Idempotency signal written by /devx-init at the top of the file. Read by /devx-init's upgrade-mode detector (ini507) — present + parseable → upgrade rerun; present + missing version → corrupt-config halt; absent → fresh init. Bump on each release; do not hand-edit.

init_partial.description: Set to true by /devx-init's failure-mode handler (ini506) when init has deferred work (gh-not-auth, BMAD-install fail, no-remote). Other devx commands refuse to spawn in modes ≥ BETA while this flag is true. Cleared by `devx init --resume-gh` once all deferred ops succeed.

_internal.description: Reserved for devx-internal flags. Not user-tunable; flipped by /devx itself or /devx-learn (Phase 5+) as part of canary rollouts. Idempotent extension per cfg201 contract; `additionalProperties: true` lets future devx versions add new internal flags without forcing existing configs to re-init (cfg203 silently accepts unknown subkeys here).

mode.description: Strategic axis #1 — what kind of risk surface this project sits on. Sets default gates across every subsystem (see docs/MODES.md).

shape.description: Strategic axis #2 — what shape this project is in. Steers parallelism, tests-first vs tests-alongside, and ceremony heaviness.

thoroughness.description: Strategic axis #3 — how much ceremony to apply. send-it = minimum, balanced = default, thorough = full party-mode + focus-group + retro.

integration_branch.description: Long-lived integration branch (typically `develop`). Set to null for single-branch projects (the merge gate becomes the deploy gate).

browser_harness.description: Which browser harness drives Layer-2 QA. `claude-in-chrome` means the attended agent drives a real Chrome session instead of a scripted runner.

events.description: Map of event-name → notification level. Event names are open-ended (devx upgrades add new events); level enum is closed.

quiet_hours.description: Local-time HH:MM-HH:MM range during which `push` is muted (MANUAL.md still files).

linger.description: systemd-only: invoke `loginctl enable-linger <user>` so the manager/concierge units survive logout. Ignored on launchd (macOS) and Task Scheduler (Windows). Default: false.

stack.description: Single-project stack block. Mutually exclusive with `projects` — enforced by the load-time validator (cfg203), not the schema. Phase 5 (local CI) reads `lint`/`test`/`coverage`/`pre_push` to gate merges.

projects.description: Monorepo-shape stack block. Each entry is a project with its own lint/test/coverage commands. Mutually exclusive with `stack` — enforced by the load-time validator (cfg203), not the schema, since JSON Schema's `not.required` idiom is awkward to express here without tripping ajv strict mode.

reading_guide_roles.description: Column set for the Reading Guide on a design human render — the annotated ToC that doubles as an audience map. Defaults to the plan-stage critique lenses ([pm, architect, dev, qa]) so the document is mapped in a vocabulary the repo already uses rather than a parallel one. Columns are the scarce resource: add a role only when it would carry at least one ● outside Overview. Derivation-only — the guide's PRESENCE is never gated on config, and no personalization key can suppress it.

learn.description: Retro-listener knobs (rtl102) read by `devx learn-watch` and the /devx-init hook install step. NOT read by the Stop/SessionEnd listener — that path resolves its queue home from DEVX_LEARN_HOME + the built-in default only, to stay inside the <500ms hook-latency budget. Malformed values fall back per key (src/lib/learn/config.ts).

idle_minutes.description: Transcript-mtime quiet window that reads as "session over", in minutes. Default 15.

retro_timeout_minutes.description: How long a spawned retro may run before the watcher retires it with outcome `timeout`, in minutes. Default 360.

home.description: Queue home (queue JSONL, done log, markers, locks, repos.json). User-global so one watcher serves many repos. A leading `~/` expands. Default `~/.claude/devx`; DEVX_LEARN_HOME overrides this at runtime.

auto_allow.description: Treat a repo nobody has reviewed as allowed instead of prompting once per repo (28b267). Default false. Turn it on to run the watcher unattended (`nohup devx learn-watch &`), where the [y/N] prompt can never be answered and every unreviewed entry would otherwise be walked past forever. A recorded `deny` in repos.json still wins, and the policy never WRITES repos.json — that file stays the record of what a human reviewed, so turning this back off restores prompting. `devx learn-watch --auto-allow` forces it on for one run.

auto_apply.description: Let an unattended /devx-learn run apply its routed framework fixes (branch → local CI → PR → mode merge gate) instead of stopping at an evidence table nobody is sitting in front of (c808b1). Default false — an unattended run that opens PRs must be opted into, not inherited by anyone who installs devx, and it is deliberately NOT implied by learn.auto_allow (that knob only lets the watcher spawn a retro). Turning it on never widens WHAT may be applied: wedge paths (.claude/**, skills/**, settings.json, anything outside the repo) and locked machinery stay proposal-only in every mode.

personalization.description: The REPO/TEAM layer (layer 4) of the preference bank documented in docs/PERSONALIZATION.md. Individual layers live in ~/.claude/devx/ and are never committed; this block is the only committed one, so it is the only one that binds contributors. It is a FLOOR, not a peer: where a value here is stricter than what an individual profile resolved, this one wins outright (PERSONALIZATION.md §2). Nothing here is a gate input — a value that would skip, weaken, auto-pass, or reorder a gate, refusal, or record is void at runtime and reported verbatim. Keys, defaults, and strictness directions are defined once in docs/PERSONALIZATION.md; this schema constrains shape only.

role.description: Prompt altitude and which next-command rows surface. A `pm` never receives git or worktree mechanics. Default `both`.

docs.layout.description: Where stage artifacts live. `workstream` (default) is the folder-per-artifact tree under engine.workstreams_root; `project-level` is the flat repo-root shape (prd.md / design.md / plan.md and their `<stage>-outline.md` counterparts) for a repo that only ever designs one thing at a time. Outline files stay human-only in BOTH layouts. Chooses the SHAPE of the tree; engine.workstreams_root names where it is rooted. See PERSONALIZATION.md §4.1.

autonomy.action_mode.description: Whether a plan-level approval covers the low-risk batch without item-level re-confirmation. `propose-only` (default) is stricter. Rails unchanged: never acts before plan approval returns; gated-artifact amendments and any delete/overwrite always confirm explicitly.

design.outline_coaching.description: How hard the Design stage pushes before agreeing your outline is complete. `exhaustive` is stricter — it additionally requires every codebase-research finding to be explicitly dispositioned by an outline bullet. Both keep the rule that the HUMAN writes the bullets. Default `standard`.

plan.phase_appetite.description: Default phase sizing proposed at the Plan stage before you are asked. Default `standard`.

review.above_threshold_shape.description: Which sanctioned Phase 4 adversarial shape runs on a substantial surface (>500 lines / multi-regex / marker-bearing). Never governs WHETHER one runs — self-review is non-skippable per CLAUDE.md. Plain single-pass is not an option: it was measured at 4 findings against a peer median of 16. Default `parallel`.

review.findings_destination.description: Where review findings are announced. The findings are recorded regardless — this routes the notification, not the record. Default `both`.

notify.channel.description: Where devx notifications go. `null` = no pings. Default null.

notify.threshold.description: How much reaches that channel. Default `blockers`.

output.verbosity.description: Narration density. `terse` NEVER suppresses: a gate verdict block, a refusal and its reason, an evidence/failure report, a void-and-report notice, or the /devx-learn friction nudge — learn-listener greps that nudge sentence verbatim, so suppressing it would silently disable retro detection. Default `full`.

docs.human_render.description: When a stage's human.md digest is refreshed from the authoritative artifact. Default `on-gate-pass`.

design.diagram_density.description: How many mermaid diagrams the human render carries. Default `standard`.

plan.wave_execution.description: Whether parallel-safe phases are offered as the default execution path. Default `opt-in`.

plan.risks_depth.description: `interrogated` (default) runs the riskiest-phase / what-breaks / rollback interrogation before the plan review loop.

execute.worktree.description: Per-spec worktree vs in-place. Default true.

execute.commit_convention.description: Commit message shape. A repo with a committed convention overrides an individual value by the §2 floor — this repo's CLAUDE.md pins `conventional`. Default `conventional`.

execute.auto_advance.description: Continue to the next ready spec after a merged one, or stop and report. Default false.

execute.pr_labels.description: Labels applied to spec PRs. Default [].

execute.reviewers.description: Reviewers requested on spec PRs. Default [].

git.pr_state.description: Whether the spec PR opens as a draft. Default `ready`.

evals.validation_source.description: Where a run of record executes. Default `both`.

qa.exploratory_depth.description: How far an attended Layer-2 pass goes before reporting. Default `brief`.

retro.depth.description: How much the retro asks for at workstream close. Default `full`.

outcome.window_days.description: Default measure_by offset armed at retro, in days. Default 28.

next.default_scope.description: What `devx next` ranks over when no scope flag is given. Default `repo`.

interview.batch_size.description: How many INTERVIEW.md questions one walk offers before checking in. Default 5.

walk.dig_depth.description: Whether a question that needs trying rather than reading may propose a spike. Default `spike-offered`.

safety.protected_paths.description: Paths that must never receive an agent commit. Add-only from an individual layer — an individual may extend this list, never shorten a committed one. Default [].

safety.production_touch.description: Posture on production-touching work. `never` (default) is the floor; `confirm` is NOT selectable by an individual where this layer committed `never`.

safety.long_op_confirm_s.description: Confirm before an operation expected to exceed this many seconds. Default 120.
